text:
Adequate nutrition is the intake and utilization of energy-giving and body
building foods and nutrients in the right proportions to maintain well-being, and
productivity.
Malnutrition manifests as stunting, underweight, wasting (kwashiorkor and
marasmus), obesity as well as deficiencies of micronutrients.
Epidemiology
- High prevalence in under-developed countries, especially sub-Saharan
Africa
